name: hold_umbrella
text: A person stands still holding the shaft of an open umbrella upright in their right hand just in front of the right shoulder at chest height. The right elbow points down beside the body, forearm upright. Left arm hangs relaxed. Maintain the umbrella-holding pose steadily, with only a small natural shift of weight between the feet.
